title: Handling of network rejection due to congestion control

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Back-off timer used for DNN-based congestion control. Controls when UE can reattempt PDU session establishment/modification requests for specific DNN combinations.

entities.name: Timer T3584
entities.description: Back-off timer used for S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion control. Controls when UE can reattempt PDU session requests for specific S-NSSAI and DNN combinations.

entities.name: Timer T3585
entities.description: Back-off timer used for S-NSSAI only based congestion control. Controls when UE can reattempt PDU session requests for specific S-NSSAI.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message sent by network to reject PDU session modification request, containing congestion control information.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information element containing timer value for congestion control back-off timers T3396, T3584, or T3585.

entities.name: 5GSM cause value
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for rejection, including congestion control causes #26, #67, and #69.

entities.name: Congestion control handling procedure
entities.description: UE procedure for handling network rejection due to congestion control, involving back-off timers and request restrictions.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM mobility management state where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: Timer neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where back-off timer value indicates an active timer duration (not zero or deactivated).

entities.name: Timer deactivated
entities.description: Condition where back-off timer value indicates timer is deactivated (permanent restriction until specific events).

entities.name: Timer value zero
entities.description: Condition where back-off timer value indicates zero, allowing immediate reattempt.

entities.name: Request restriction during congestion
entities.description: UE behavior property restricting PDU session establishment/modification requests while back-off timer is running or deactivated.

relations.description: Procedure starts timer T3396 when DNN-based congestion is detected
Procedure starts timer T3584 when S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion is detected
Procedure starts timer T3585 when S-NSSAI only based congestion is detected
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains Back-off timer value IE
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains 5GSM cause value IE
Active timer condition establishes request restriction property
Deactivated timer condition establishes permanent request restriction property
Zero timer value condition removes request restriction property
Timer T3396 continues running when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
Timer T3584 continues running when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
Timer T3585 continues running when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
Back-off timer value IE guards by timer active condition
Back-off timer value IE guards by timer deactivated condition
Back-off timer value IE guards by timer zero condition
